summary.done: Implemented LoadChildSession in internal/config/session.go to resolve child sessions from parent tool-call links. Validates child file path (parentDir/agents/ChildSessionName/chat.json), child ID, ParentID, RootID, ParentToolCallID, and depth. Returns loaded document and runtime directory for recursive resolution. Added 9 comprehensive tests covering success, missing child name, absent file, ID mismatches (child, parent, root, tool-call), depth mismatch, grandchild recursion, and no-global-scan isolation.
summary.decisions: Placed LoadChildSession in config package alongside ChildSessionDir and LoadSessionDocAt since it is a pure filesystem resolution + identity validation primitive. Uses ChildSessionDir for path construction. Validates all 5 identity fields plus depth. Returns child runtime directory for recursive descendant resolution.
summary.tradeoffs: Returns first validation error rather than accumulating all errors for brevity. LoadChildSession is in config package (not chat) to keep it a pure resolution primitive independent of runtime state.
